    • listLocations

      public List<? extends LookupLocation> listLocations(String permissionCode, List<String> ibxs, String providerAccountNumber, String aSideIbx, String connectionService, Boolean details)
      Description copied from interface: Lookups
      Lists the locations the current user may order at, for the given permission code, with optional filters.

      Maps to GET /colocations/v2/locations (Get Locations by permission code). The providerAccountNumber, aSideIbx and connectionService filters apply only when permissionCode is CROSS_CONNECT.

      Specified by:
      listLocations in interface Lookups
      Parameters:
      permissionCode - the permission code (CROSS_CONNECT, WORK_VISIT or SHIPMENTS)
      ibxs - the IBX codes to filter by, or null
      providerAccountNumber - the service provider's (Z-side) account number, or null
      aSideIbx - the A-side IBX used to fetch Z-side details, or null
      connectionService - the connection service type used to fetch Z-side details, or null
      details - when true, returns cage, cabinet and account details, or null for the default
      Returns:
      the list of permitted locations
